items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: And the saxophones was Edward Inge and Jimmy Dudley and Prince Robinson... And the saxophones was Rupert Cole and Edward Inge and Bob Carroll

ctx.x: Yeah, and Edward Inge had taken George Robinson's place by then, you see. And, of course, Prince Cuffee Robertson was still there. And Edward Cuffy was the other trombone. He came in Claude Jones' place in 1929 when Claude left McKinney's to go to Fletcher.
